question: In which Indian state is the cave site of Bagh located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bagh Caves are located in the state of Madhya Pradesh in India.
 
• They are a group of nine rock-cut monuments famous for their exquisite paintings.
 
• The caves are situated in the Dhar district, near the town of Bagh.
 
• Bagh Caves are known for their Buddhist mural paintings similar to those found in Ajanta Caves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bagh Caves**

 
 
• Bagh Caves are renowned for their ancient Buddhist rock-cut architecture and paintings, dating back to the late 4th to 6th century AD.
 
• The caves were excavated on the southern slopes of the Vindhya Range, a major mountain range in central India.
 
• The caves served as viharas, which are Buddhist monasteries, providing living quarters for monks.
 
• The most significant cave is the Cave 4, also known as Rang Mahal, which is adorned with intricate murals depicting stories from the Jataka tales and other Buddhist texts.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh**
 
 
• Madhya Pradesh is a state located in central India, often referred to as the "Heart of India" due to its geographical location.
 
• The state is known for its rich cultural heritage, historical monuments, and natural beauty.
 
• It is home to several UNESCO World Heritage Sites, including the Khajuraho Group of Monuments, the Buddhist Monuments at Sanchi, and the rock shelters of Bhimbetka.
 
• Madhya Pradesh has a significant tribal population and is known for its diverse traditions, arts, and crafts.
